chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad al-Kufi, from Muhammad ibn Ahmad al-Nahdi, from Muhammad ibn al-Walid, from Aban, from Abi al-'Abbas, from Abi 'Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
Women have neither pardon nor retaliation.

key_terms.عَفْوٌ: pardon; remission of a claim or retaliation
key_terms.قَالَ: he said; marking the beginning of the Imam’s statement
key_terms.قَوَدٌ: retaliation; qiṣāṣ or legal retributive punishment
key_terms.لِلنِّسَاءِ: for women; referring to women as legal parties in this ruling

ai.seo_question: Do women have the right to grant pardon or demand retaliation in cases of qiṣāṣ according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling in the context of adjudication among heirs or entitled parties. It states that women do not hold the authority of remission or the right to demand qiṣāṣ in this specific legal setting.
